dataset: Synthetic stand-in modeled on state environmental-agency groundwater monitoring records for a closed LLRW disposal site. Generated for this exercise; treat as the authoritative record for the story.

data/tritium_readings.csv.description: Quarterly tritium measurements (pCi/L) from 10 on-site monitoring wells.
data/tritium_readings.csv.notes: Sampling gaps exist (some quarters unsampled). No data has been collected or digitized after 2015-12-31.
data/tritium_readings.csv.source: State environmental agency quarterly monitoring reports, 1982-2015 (synthetic replica)

data/wells.csv.description: Well metadata: location, depth, distance from the disposal trench.

epa_tritium_mcl_pci_l.source: US EPA National Primary Drinking Water Regulations, 40 CFR 141.66 (real value)
